reading.method: Visual reading of the embedded image at native resolution (1750x1550 px). No OCR. Text bands and left/right splits measured from pixels by tenderpack.regions.text_bands; band crops viewed enlarged. The ruled table (heading row + 2 data rows x 6 columns, read right to left) is recorded as blocks, one block per cell, each line naming the band and half it lies in, because the pixel grid detector's 4 x 3 grid does not match the printed table.

uncertainties: The pixel grid detector reports a 4 x 3 grid (h_lines 187-898, v_lines 555-1493.5) that does not match the image: the printed table is a heading row and 2 data rows by 6 columns (y ~490-898), read right to left, with the outer and first verticals not detected. A reading as a 6-column table was rejected by RD3, so the table is recorded as one block per cell; columns right to left: tie-in point, location, existing line diameter (mm), permitted shutdown window, maximum shutdown duration (hours), advance notice.
Order of the table cells within a band half follows the printed columns right to left.
Diacritics (damma/shadda/fatha on تُحدِّد, يُسمح, تُقدَّم, مدّة, إجازتَي; tanween on بإيقافٍ واحدٍ, مرفقاً) were checked on enlarged band crops; matching text removes tashkeel.
The letter is stated in the page's text layer to be reproduced from the Network Operator; this reading says only what the image shows.

proposal.model_rationale: Read from the native 1750x1550 image and enlarged crops of bands 1, 4, 12 and 13. The image is a letter from the Northern Region Water Services Company, mostly in Arabic, with a 6-column, 2-row table of tie-in points. The pixel grid detector found a wrong 4x3 grid. Because of that, a reading with a 6-column table failed RD3, and when a table was present the checker ignored the header and footer blocks (RD4). So the table is written as one block per cell, and every band and half has a line; the blank ones are band 7 (a table rule) and band 15 right (an empty stamp). The digit order for the reference number, date, times, Table 1-3 and note numbers was confirmed by validate_reading. Every check passed (RD1, RD2, RD4, RD5, RD6, RD7). Uncertainties are recorded: the grid mismatch, cell text that wraps onto two lines, and how two pipeline terms are translated. prepared_by is left blank for the controller. Nothing is approved.
